name: start_billing_run
title: Start a billing run
description: Start a billing run for a firm. The run takes 30 to 90 seconds and advances through four phases. This call returns immediately with a handle rather than waiting. Poll the handle until the run reaches a terminal status. Starting a run writes to the billing system of record.

executed_by_advisor_id.description: Advisor the run is executed for. Must be an advisor the caller may act for.

outputSchema.title: StartedRunHandle
outputSchema.description: A started billing run, with the handle and the tool to poll it with.
